<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - use the plain white backdrop from <Picture 1> throughout the shot.

detailed_description:
The target video uses the anime drawing style and plain white environment of <Picture 1>. The character remains the same short-haired man throughout, with the illustrated outfit and equipment moving naturally with his body.
[Shot 1] The camera shows <Subject 1> in the floor-supported pose and orientation seen at the beginning of <Video 1>, against <Subject 2>. His short parted black hair, facial structure, green cloak over the cropped brown jacket, light shirt and cravat, dark trousers, pale crossing harness straps, tall dark boots and paired hip gear retain the appearance established by <Picture 1>. His posture is animated according to <Subject 3>, rather than holding the standing pose of the reference image. Keep the side-facing camera direction and subject scale of <Video 1>. Preserve the body regions visible in the source at each time, including its visible head and hands, within the same frame boundaries. Follow the source framing throughout the motion.
The character begins low to the ground with his arms supporting his weight. Following the progression visible in <Video 1>, his elbows bend and his chest moves close to the floor. His hands and lower-body support points follow the reference contacts and their changes. He then pushes through his arms, raises his chest and extends his back as the source performer does. His shoulders, elbows, wrists, hips and head follow the same coordinated changes of position and orientation. Preserve the reference movement's pauses and transitions, including the portions between the larger poses, so each stage occurs at its corresponding point in the source motion.
As the reference motion continues, the elbows remain extended while the head lowers and the upper back rounds upward. The visible hands and knee support remain on the floor as shown in <Video 1>. Continue this straight-arm, rounded-back and lowered-head phase through the final source frame, retaining the source sequence's pace, direction and range. The cloak, jacket and harness follow the bending and extension while preserving their appearance and attachment to the character. Keep the man recognizable during low poses, foreshortening and turns of the head; his face and short hair remain consistent with the target image. The plain white backdrop remains visible around the moving body throughout the shot. Maintain the reference clip's continuous camera view and overall framing so the body motion can be followed from beginning to end, with the target figure fully participating in each motion phase.
